en.question: How long is Tali Pro included with my device?
en.answer:
• Founders Limited Series — 24 months of Tali Pro included
• Limited Edition Series — 12 months of Tali Pro included
• Standard Edition — Basic included for life; Pro available for a small fee

Once your included period ends, everything keeps working — you simply return to Basic unless you choose to continue with Pro.

es.question: ¿Por cuánto tiempo está incluido Tali Pro con mi dispositivo?
es.answer:
• Founders Limited Series — 24 meses de Tali Pro incluidos
• Limited Edition Series — 12 meses de Tali Pro incluidos
• Standard Edition — Basic incluido de por vida; Pro disponible por una cuota pequeña

Cuando termina tu periodo incluido, todo sigue funcionando — simplemente regresas a Basic, a menos que decidas continuar con Pro.
